guidetextdraw._value:
JOB SUMMARY 

Instructions: Briefly summarize the overall purpose of the position in a few specific statements or a brief paragraph. Other duties as assigned.

 Examples:

  • "To supervise the day-to-day activities of the unit." 
  • "To plan, manage, and direct the resources of the School of Agriculture to achieve the mission of the school."
guidetextdraw.name: textdraw1559735584793

guidetextdraw_1488403992._value:
SIGNIFICANT CHANGES FROM PREVIOUS JOB DUTIES (IF APPLICABLE)

Instructions: List the changes that have been made to the position since it was lasted reviewed by Human Resources.

Example: The audit function has been added to this position as a result of a reorganzation, which includes....
guidetextdraw_1488403992.name: textdraw_14884039921559735844812

guidetextdraw_1757674942._value:
DESCRIBE THE POSITION(S) THAT REPORT TO THE INCUMBENT

Example: Administrative Support Assistant II, Position number 00023456
guidetextdraw_1757674942.name: textdraw_17576749421559735940364

guidetextdraw_419447852._value:
MAJOR JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: INDICATE % OF TIME FOR EACH (TOTAL % MUST ADD UP TO 100%)

Instructions: Group the major functions of the position by major job responsibility and indicate the percent of time for each.The total must add up to 100%.

Examples:

  • 55% - Coaches and Manages Staff in to Achieve Programmatic Goals and Objectives.
  • 30% - Allocates Resources (Capital, Fiscal, and Staff) and Manages Assets.
  • 10% - Communicates Program Progress to Top Management
  • 5% - Other Duties as Assigned
guidetextdraw_419447852.name: textdraw_4194478521559736031066

guidetextdraw_1734480878._value:
LIST PRIMARY DUTIES ASSOCIATED WITH EACH MAJOR JOB RESPONSIBILITY

Instructions: Using each major job responsibility listed above as a heading, list examples of the individual duties and/or responsibilities that are associated with each major job responsibility. Each list does not have to be all inclusive, but should provide clear examples of the typical work performed.

Examples: “55% - Coaches and Manages Staff to Achieve Programmatic Goals and Objectives."

  • Determines program goals and establishes methods and timelines for their accomplishment.
  • Supervises the day-to-day activities staff to ensure the accomplishment of goals and objectives.
  • Hires, trains, coaches and counsels, evaluates individual performance, and makes recommendations concerning retention, promotion, and termination.
guidetextdraw_1734480878.name: textdraw_17344808781559736328048

guidetextdraw_1585098486._value:
ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS

Please note: A background check (including a criminal records check) must be completed satisfactorily before any candidate can be offered a position with the CSU. Failure to satisfactorily complete the background check may affect the application status of applicants or continued employment of current CSU employees who apply for the position.

 Instructions: Briefly describe the minimum job related experience and/ or education and equivalents that would provide the knowledge, skills, and abilities that an incumbent must possess to satisfactorily perform the duties and responsibilities of the position as described previously on this document.

 Example: The minimum qualifications for this position would normally be obtained through education, training and/or job experience which provided the employee with an understanding of administrative operations and effective management of human resources capital in a multilayered organization.
guidetextdraw_1585098486.name: textdraw_15850984861559736542544

guidetextdraw_673627888._value:
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Instructions: List additional knowledge, skills, and abilities that would enhance an incumbent's ability to perform the work of the position. Provide examples of level of education and types of certification and their equivalents where appropriate.
guidetextdraw_673627888.name: textdraw_6736278881559736665309

guidetextdraw_1566557095._value:
LICENSE/CERTIFICATION

Instructions: List any job related certificate(s) and/or license(s) that the incumbent must possess to be appointed into the position. Provide a brief explanation for each requirement listed.

Example: Valid California Driver's License. Position requires the use of a state vehicle to transport to events and visit schools and other outside constituents at variable hours.
guidetextdraw_1566557095.name: textdraw_15665570951559736755834

guidetextdraw_541674837._value:
SPECIAL WORKING CONDITIONS

Regular attendance is considered an essential job function; the inability to meet attendance requirements may preclude the employee from retaining employment.

Instructions: List any special or unusual working conditions to which the incumbent will be exposed.

Example: Works on uneven surfaces such as gravel covered and pitched roofs.
guidetextdraw_541674837.name: textdraw_5416748371559736858847

guidetextdraw._value:
COMPLIANCE/REGULATIONS 

For purposes of the CSU Background Check Policy Requirements, please identify by checking the appropriate box below if  this position is considered a “sensitive” position.
guidetextdraw.name: textdraw1559738442585

guidetextdraw_1324369183._value: Sensitive positions are designed by the CSU as requiring heightened scrutiny of individuals holding the positon, based on potential for harm to children, concerns for the safety and security of the people, animals, or property, or heightened risk for financial loss to the CSU or individuals in the university community.
guidetextdraw_1324369183.name: textdraw_13243691831559738715815

guidetextdraw_768330485._value:
For the purpose of identifying accurately if this position is or should be designated as a Conflict of Interest position, does or will the incumbent be making, participating in, or influencing decisions regarding: 

  • The physical master plan of the University;
  • The total enrollment of the University;
  • The license, lease, purchase, or sale of real property of the University or for the University;
  • Purchase of supplies, materials, commodities, machinery, equipment, services, or work for the University, school, department or  area; and/or
  • Entering into amending construction contracts or service contracts in connection with construction contracts for the University.
guidetextdraw_768330485.name: textdraw_7683304851559738752963

guidetextdraw_2058408095._value: Please ensure the job responsibilities reflect the aforementioned.
guidetextdraw_2058408095.name: textdraw_20584080951559738848724

guidetextdraw_1158503658.name: textHeading
